Title: A Guide to Function Calling in OpenAI | Mirascope
URL: https://mirascope.com/blog/openai-function-calling

Back in July I wrote [Tool (aka Function Calling) Best Practices](https://medium.com/@laurentkubaski/tool-or-function-calling-best-practices-a5165a33d5f1) and thought that it would be a good idea to write an actual example that puts everything in practice. The program implements [the standard tool calling flow](https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/function-calling#the-tool-calling-flow). To implement **Step 1** from the tool calling flow — see chapter 3 — the program needs to describe to the model what the tools are: this is done using JSON Schemas and a best practice is to automatically generate them, for example using the OpenAI SDK builtin pydantic_function_tool() utility.
